purpose: Measure native Qwen3.8 understanding on eight existing natural-footage excerpts without changing the accepted selector or any runtime file after answers are seen.

freeze_contract.incomplete_or_preflight_failed_attempts: retain but exclude from accepted results
freeze_contract.task66_procedural_fixture_and_scores: immutable regression control outside the natural denominator

source.original_commit_subject: Go minimal: real footage, one line, one engine
source.license: Apache-2.0, the covering repository license at the source commit; no per-asset exception is recorded
source.redistribution_and_evaluation: permitted by the covering Apache-2.0 license; retain source commit/blob identity and license
source.excerpt_encoding: H.264 libx264, 256x160, 30 fps, CRF 12, two B-frames, exact selected source-frame ranges, PTS reset to zero in presentation order; 256x160 is the exact native smart-resize target; native stream duration takes precedence over container duration for fps and nominal timestamps
source.review: All source endpoints and review sheets were visually inspected before any model request. Only forest, whale, and dandelion real-footage scenes are included; scene transitions, rendered planet, end cards, and text overlays are excluded.
source.scope_limit: Eight non-overlapping clips come from one compilation and three scene types; they are not a representative natural-video corpus.

selection.runtime_changes: none; evaluation starts at official main 413cc9b4114ac83696925aeb43577e39853977a8
selection.quality_anchor_rule: Every preregistered answer is directly visible in declared source frames. All five arm/budget selections must contain evidence before freezing; no case is excluded for a selection miss.

scoring.expect_all_semantics: every preregistered term must occur in the casefolded raw answer
scoring.expect_any_group_semantics: at least one preregistered canonical-language term must occur in the casefolded raw answer
limitations: substring matching can over- or under-count linguistic variants
three deterministic repetitions are not independent semantic examples
eight excerpts from one footage compilation and three scene types do not establish generalized natural-video or perceptual quality

request_contract.metadata_sent_to_model: only neutral video data URLs and exact questions; no source name, answer, expected term, source range, or review metadata

measurement.mode_execution: fresh serial stack then fresh batch-four stack on the same explicitly idle physical GPU 1; never simultaneously resident
measurement.prefix_cache: disabled; prefix_reused=0 for every request including warmup
measurement.native_evidence: exact selected RGB, source frame and source PTS/presentation order, temporal-2 pair-first timestamps, grid/token/mRoPE consistency, serial/batch and repetition parity, complete binary/model/source provenance

analysis_plan.paired_unit: case x execution mode; sum its three measured hits, then classify improved/worsened/unchanged
analysis_plan.sign_test: exact two-sided sign test over discordant paired case/mode units; zero discordant pairs gives p=1.0
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Wilson 95 percent interval over 48 request-level measured answers per arm/budget; repetitions are not independent semantic examples
analysis_plan.per_case_reporting: every raw answer and hit by case/mode/repetition/arm/budget, plus every miss, improvement, regression, and request identity
analysis_plan.latency_outliers: Tukey upper fence Q3+1.5*IQR within each measured mode/arm/budget and metric total/native_elapsed; if IQR=0, every value above Q3 is an outlier; no value is removed
no_regression_technical_gates: 320 completed and native-valid requests with cold prefixes
304 exact default/uniform, serial/batch-four, and repetition parity checks
default-8 and uniform-8 answers and native diagnostics byte-identical
all selected RGB/source/PTS/temporal-2/mRoPE and temporal first/last-anchor checks pass
exclusive GPU1, in_flight=0, bounded residual memory, and post-stop cleanup
complete evidence, frozen fixture, unchanged Task66 control, and checksum verification
analysis_plan.acceptance_behavior: This is an evaluation-only technical gate. Quality improvement is not required and no answer triggers a runtime edit or a generalized significance claim.

cases.question: What large living things dominate this landscape? Answer with one noun.

ground_truth.derivation: Multiple large trees with trunks and dense canopies are directly visible around the grass clearing throughout the excerpt.

cases.question: 穿过树冠、照亮草地的是什么？只回答名称。

ground_truth.derivation: 明亮的太阳及穿过树冠射向草地的光束在所有证据帧直接可见。

cases.question: ¿Qué animal está saliendo del océano? Responde solo con el nombre del animal.

ground_truth.derivation: La cabeza, la boca y el cuerpo de la ballena que emerge son directamente visibles durante todo el fragmento.

cases.question: 海から姿を見せている動物は何ですか？動物名だけで答えてください。

ground_truth.derivation: 海面から現れる大型海洋生物の頭部、口、体型からクジラと直接同定できる。

cases.question: Quel mammifère marin est visible hors de l'eau ? Réponds avec un seul nom.

ground_truth.derivation: La tête, la bouche et le corps massif hors de l'eau identifient directement une baleine dans les images sources.

cases.question: Welche Blume mit weißen, sich lösenden Samen ist zu sehen? Antworte nur mit dem Namen.

ground_truth.derivation: Die weiße runde Pusteblume mit sich ablösenden Samenschirmchen ist im Vordergrund eindeutig sichtbar.

cases.question: Quale pianta con un'infiorescenza bianca e soffice occupa il primo piano? Rispondi solo con il nome.

ground_truth.derivation: Il soffione bianco in primo piano e gli acheni che si staccano identificano direttamente il dente di leone.

cases.question: O que se desprende da planta e flutua pelo ar? Responda apenas com o nome.

ground_truth.derivation: Pequenas sementes com estruturas plumosas se soltam da inflorescência e flutuam à direita nos quadros de evidência.
